description.text: One of the two expansions released on 27 October 2023, together with Future Flash, built around the Ancient Paradox Pokémon. From this pair, cards of Ancient and Future Pokémon, and of the Trainers made for them, carry an Ancient or Future mark and a specially designed right half. Roaring Moon ex and Sandy Shocks ex lead it, with Scream Tail, Brute Bonnet, Slither Wing, Ancient Booster Energy Capsule, Earthen Vessel and the Supporter Professor Sada's Vitality. Golisopod ex, Armarouge ex and the Tera Pokémon Tsareena ex join them, and Team Star's Mela appears as a Supporter for the first time. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 66, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Supporters, Special Art Rare cards, and gold Ultra Rare Roaring Moon ex, Luxurious Cape and basic Darkness Energy. In English many of its cards came out in Paradox Rift in November 2023.
